prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” implant dentist for everyone—the right choice depends on your bone and gum health, whether you need one tooth or a full arch, and who will place and restore the implant.

A good Dallas starting point is **Dr. Laura N. Rabe at Dallas Periodontics and Dental Implants**. The practice lists her as a **board-certified periodontist and dental implant surgeon**. For a restorative-focused second opinion, **Dr. Daniel Tan at Dallas Dental Implant Center** is a prosthodontist with specialty training in advanced prosthodontics. These are starting points, not endorsements.

Before choosing, ask who performs the surgery and who makes the final tooth, how many similar cases they handle, what the full cost includes, and what happens if the implant fails. Get a written treatment plan—and consider a second opinion, especially for full-arch work or bone grafting.
